verdict: The MB1 pk8 candidate fails statistically and is unsupported substantively. (a) Rank test: its max-of-4 config-runs beating a max-of-24 shuffle-null has null probability 0.143 under exchangeability -- no correction applied yet. (b) Its IoC 0.06656 is BELOW every real sibling plaintext at n=153 (0.0701-0.0778). (c) 66% of that IoC comes from just two letters (A 16.3%, B ~13.7%); quadgram -7.94/letter vs random -8.23. (d) HONESTLY: its sorted-profile chi2 of 18.3 is only mildly elevated (all five siblings score 6.8-13.7) and is NOT by itself decisive -- the pk8 case is killed by the rank test and the sub-plaintext IoC, not by the profile test. The pk9 MB1 decrypt at chi2 33.0 is much worse.
